module_summary: guifilemgr.cpp is the main-menu File Manager dialog (drive list, folder paging, mark/copy/cut/paste/delete/rename, PSU pack/unpack, ELF run) on top of core/filemgr.cpp and vmcsaves. guigame.cpp holds the per-game settings dialogs: VMC menu/create/rebuild/saves, GSM, cheats, PADEMU and pad macros, OSD language, the Compatibility page with Loader Core and Neutrino rows, and the load/apply/save/remove of all per-game and global keys; it also has the opt-in automatic VMC creation used at launch. guiframe.* is a frame-time watchdog and debug FPS meter fed from Gui end-of-frame; guigameid.h declares the GameID barcode class implemented in guigameid.cpp.

findings.title: guigame.cpp redeclares genvmc.h's status struct and uses raw devctl codes; system.cpp keeps an unused stale createVMCparam_t copy
findings.problem: statusVMCparam_t at guigame.cpp:128-134 is a hand copy of genvmc.h:36-42, and the GENVMC_DEVCTL_STATUS/ABORT codes are written as 0xC0DE0003/0xC0DE0002 literals; EE code already includes modules/vmc/genvmc/genvmc.h (sysvmc.cpp:65, vmcrebuild.cpp:19). system.cpp:69-76 defines an older 5-field createVMCparam_t that nothing in system.cpp uses (the real one with VMC_flags is genvmc.h:26-34).
findings.fix: Include modules/vmc/genvmc/genvmc.h in guigame.cpp, delete the local typedef and use GENVMC_DEVCTL_STATUS, GENVMC_DEVCTL_ABORT and GENVMC_STAT_AVAIL; use GENVMC_DEVCTL_CREATE_VMC at sysvmc.cpp:272. Delete the typedef at system.cpp:69-76.
findings.benefit: ~15 source lines removed; one struct definition instead of three, so a layout change in genvmc.h cannot silently desync the EE side; no ELF change (INFERRED: typedefs emit no code)
findings.evidence: Grep statusVMCparam_t|0xC0DE000 over src/RiptOPL (excluding .github): guigame.cpp:128-134,144,228,611,706-740; genvmc.h:11-13,36-42; sysvmc.cpp:272 literal 0xC0DE0001 while sysvmc.cpp:65 already includes genvmc.h. Grep createVMCparam_t|genvmc in src/platform/system.cpp: only the typedef line 76 and the module load at 421, so the typedef is unused. Read genvmc.h fully: plain C types, no IOP-only includes.

findings.title: Dead stores in guiGameShowCompatConfig/VMC menu; compatMode, dmaMode, coreLoader, hexid etc. are statics used as temporaries
findings.problem: guiGameShowCompatConfig recomputes compatMode (1818-1823) and reads dmaMode, coreLoader, hexid and altStartup (1832-1835), but guiGameApplyConfig re-reads every one of them from the dialog before use (1858-1862, 1866, 1881, 1997, 2003) and nothing else reads them. coreLoader at 819 is never read (598 overwrites it first), and the ternary at 599 is an identity: guiGameResolveEffectiveCore already maps key 2 to gDefaultCoreLoader (262). configSourceID, dmaMode, compatMode, coreLoader, hexid, altStartup and hexDiscID are each written before read inside one function.
findings.fix: Delete 1818-1823 and 1832-1835 (keep only the COMPAT_LOADFROMDISC branch), delete line 819, replace the 599 ternary with the core value, and turn the listed statics into function locals.
findings.benefit: ~13 source lines removed and ~120 bytes of .bss moved to stack (INFERRED: 4 ints + hexid[32] + altStartup[32] + hexDiscID[15] + configSourceID); removes cross-dialog shared state
findings.evidence: Grep -w configSourceID|dmaMode|compatMode|coreLoader|hexDiscID and hexid|altStartup in guigame.cpp (all static, file-local): every read is preceded by a write in the same function (LoadConfig 2524-2551, 2564-2575; ApplyConfig 1858-1885, 1997-2005; VMC 598-599); 819 has no later read. Read guiGameResolveEffectiveCore 248-269: returns gDefaultCoreLoader when key==2, otherwise key or 0/1. .github/scripts/test_issues_830_831.py:28 asserts the assignment text, which line 598 still contains.

findings.title: Global/per-game source-switch block copied in four dialog updaters
findings.problem: Cheats, PADEMU, pad macro and OSD updaters each carry the same 9-line block: if the source row changed to Global, gameMenuLoadConfig(dia), configRemoveKey(source key), reload; if changed to Per-game, configSetInt(source key), reload. They differ only by dialog, key, source value and load function. The GSM updater (880-901) is the same with a third arm.
findings.fix: Add one static helper taking (previous, now, dialog, source key, load function) and call it from the four updaters; leave the GSM three-way arm as it is or route its two common arms through the helper.
findings.justification: The same block exists four times (36 lines); a ~12-line helper plus four one-line calls removes about 20 lines net.
findings.benefit: ~20 source lines net (INFERRED: 4 x 9 lines replaced by 4 calls + ~12-line helper); a few hundred bytes of .text (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read the five updaters; gameMenuLoadConfig(struct UIItem*) is declared at include/menusys.h:145 and CONFIG_ITEM_* are const char* macros (include/config.h:77), configRemoveKey takes const char* (config.h:327), so one helper signature fits all four. Load functions share the signature (config_set_t*, config_set_t*).

findings.title: guiGameVMCSavesSync duplicates vmcRebuildSync (PFS device sync of a path)
findings.problem: Both functions take the part of a path up to ':' when it starts with "pfs", copy it into a 16-byte buffer and call fileXioSync(device, 0), logging a failure; the only difference is that vmcRebuildSync reads gVMCRebuild.card and returns the result. guigame.cpp already includes vmcrebuild.h and vmcrebuild.cpp is in the main ELF (src/sources).
findings.fix: Give vmcRebuildSync a path parameter, export it from vmcrebuild.h, and delete guiGameVMCSavesSync, calling the exported one at its three call sites (445, 458, 468).
findings.benefit: ~10 source lines net (INFERRED: 12-line function removed, 1 prototype and a parameter added); ~100 bytes .text (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep fileXioSync( over src: guigame.cpp:409, vmcrebuild.cpp:99, hddsupport.cpp:2538 (fixed prefix, different). Read vmcrebuild.cpp:87-103 and guigame.cpp:398-411 side by side: same strncmp/strchr/memcpy logic. guigame.cpp:30 includes include/vmcrebuild.h.

findings.title: fmIsMcPath is a third verbatim copy of the mc0:/mc1: path test (fmIsMc, suIsMc)
findings.problem: The same one-line body exists as static fmIsMc in core/filemgr.cpp, static fmIsMcPath in guifilemgr.cpp (which already includes filemgr.h) and static suIsMc in the updater overlay's selfupdate.cpp.
findings.fix: Make fmIsMc non-static with a prototype in include/filemgr.h; delete fmIsMcPath and suIsMc and call fmIsMc.
findings.benefit: ~7 source lines net (INFERRED); small .text saving only if the compiler did not inline all copies (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep 'static int \w*IsMc' over src: filemgr.cpp:82, guifilemgr.cpp:69, selfupdate.cpp:117 (identical bodies, read). guifilemgr.cpp:47 includes include/filemgr.h; filemgr.cpp is in src/core, compiled into every main ELF (brief: ps2.yaml:641).

findings.title: Two separate static int sel[FM_MAX] buffers in guifilemgr.cpp
findings.problem: fmToClipboard and fmDeleteSelection each own a static 512-entry int selection buffer; the two never run at the same time (both are called from fmActions, one per dialog result), so one buffer is enough.
findings.fix: Use one file-scope selection buffer for both functions (or allocate it with the other File Manager buffers in guiShowFileManager).
findings.benefit: 2 KB .bss saved (INFERRED: 512 x 4 bytes); about 1 line
findings.evidence: Read guifilemgr.cpp:360-386 and 487-514; FM_MAX is 512 (line 50); callers are fmActions 598-607 only, sequential, no recursion.

findings.title: GSM_1080P is always defined, yet guigame.cpp keeps #ifdef/#else guards for a build without it
findings.problem: Both eecore and the main ELF get GSM_1080P from the base defines (ps2.yaml:609, 644), no edition or configuration script removes it, and test_ps2build_configurations.py:61 asserts it is present. The #else branch at 926-927 (28-mode list) and the seven #ifdef/#endif pairs are for a build that cannot be produced. gsm.cpp:142 and ee_core gsm_engine.S:182 / gsm_engine_adv.S:140 carry the same guard.
findings.fix: Drop the GSM_1080P #ifdef/#else/#endif lines in guigame.cpp (keep the 1080p code and GSM_VMODE_LAST_REAL_IDX 30); do the same in gsm.cpp and the two .S files.
findings.benefit: ~14 preprocessor lines removed in guigame.cpp (counted from the cited ranges); no ELF change (INFERRED: the define is always on)
findings.evidence: Grep GSM_1080P over src/RiptOPL: ps2.yaml:609,644 (base defines), no hit in tools/ (build_edition.py, build_configuration.py, lite_devices.py), test_ps2build_configurations.py:61 assertIn; code hits guigame.cpp 924,975,1584,1634,1894,2262, gsm.cpp:142, gsm_engine.S:182, gsm_engine_adv.S:140; legacy Makefile:242 only.

findings.title: GameIdBarcode: public header and class for a single file-local use
findings.problem: include/guigameid.h is included only by guigameid.cpp; the class is constructed once in guiShowGameID (210-211) and draw() is called only from show(). The serial is also capped at 11 characters twice (cleanSerial 88-89 and buildPacket 96-98).
findings.fix: Delete include/guigameid.h and turn the class into static functions (or a file-local struct) inside guigameid.cpp; drop the second 11-character cap in buildPacket.
findings.benefit: ~15 source lines net (INFERRED: 27-line header removed, ~12 lines of declarations kept in the .cpp); no ELF change expected (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep GameIdBarcode|guigameid over src/RiptOPL excluding docs: header itself, guigameid.cpp:60 (include), 67-211 (definitions and the one use at 210); .github/scripts tests only read guigameid.cpp text. Read guigameid.cpp:55-213.

findings.title: FrameClock keeps a second pair of timestamps for the debug FPS meter
findings.problem: Under __DEBUG, endFrame stores prev_/cur_ with a second clock() call right after computing nowUs, so cur_ - prev_ is the same frame length already held in lastUs_. The header also carries a six-line investigation banner about a swallowed navigation step rather than what the class does.
findings.fix: Delete prev_, cur_ and the __DEBUG block in endFrame; compute fps() from lastUs_. Shorten the header banner to one line.
findings.benefit: ~10 source lines removed; one clock() syscall per frame fewer in debug builds (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep gFrames|FrameClock: endFrame from gui.cpp:125, fps() from guioverlay.cpp:107 (inside #ifdef __DEBUG ending at 113), watchdog() from guioverlay.cpp:153. Read guiframe.cpp:11-57: mark_/lastUs_ already measure back-to-back frames.

findings.title: GSM dialog read-back (five diaGetInt + 1080p confirm) duplicated in guiGameSaveGSMGlobalConfig and guiGameApplyConfig
findings.problem: The same nine lines (diaGetInt of ENABLEGSM, GSMVMODE, X/Y offset, FIELDFIX, then guiGameConfirmGSM1080p under GSM_1080P) appear in both save legs.
findings.fix: Move the nine lines into one static helper and call it from both functions.
findings.justification: The identical block exists twice; a helper removes about 7 lines net.
findings.benefit: ~7 source lines net (INFERRED: 18 lines replaced by a ~9-line helper and two calls)
findings.evidence: Read guigame.cpp:1626-1643 and 1887-1896 side by side: identical statements in identical order.

findings.title: VMC size 8/16/32/64 MB to dialog-index mapping spelled out as if-chains in several places
findings.problem: The index<->MB mapping is written as an if/else chain in guiGameRefreshVMCConfig (MB to index) and again in guiGameShowVMCConfig (index to MB), and the valid-size test is repeated at 292 and 753; the label list is at 540.
findings.fix: Use one static const int table {8, 16, 32, 64}: index to MB becomes a table lookup, MB to index a short loop that also serves as the validity test.
findings.benefit: ~10 source lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges)
findings.evidence: Read guigame.cpp:161-207, 287-301, 540-560, 753-758; VMCSizes labels at 540 are in the same 8/16/32/64 order.
